name: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of printed circuit boards worldwide. Its products include high density interconnection, package substrates, and rigid-flex PCBs. The company manufactures and sells printed circuit boards, flexible printed circuit boards, and semiconductor products for communication devices, semiconductor packaging, memory modules, LED televisions, mobile phones, camera modules, computer peripherals, storage devices, and communication equipment. Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 is headquartered in Ansan-Si, South Korea.
